corrections.before: Any regular-symbol win starts two respins.
corrections.after: Any non-Scatter win starts two respins.

corrections.before: A count-anywhere win starts the harvest.
corrections.after: A payline win starts the harvest.

corrections.before: Refill only the largest winning symbol group in its original cells. No gravity. Stop when no group wins; multipliers 1x to 4x.
corrections.after: Refill only the longest winning line combination in place. Stop on no line win or after four refills; multipliers 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x.
No payline win plus WILD can trigger nudges even when Scatters pay.

animation: New symbols enter opposite to the actual movement direction.
